data.body:
REB-2658 test-gap remediation + 05b8 production-incident resolution — COMPLETE.

Landed 7 hardening tickets (A–G) through Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 each), then verified + closed the root incident bug 05b8.

A a01d (change 1814): fetcher per-project fan-out resilience (proven outage root cause).
B fea4 (1813): bridge-state writes adopt shared write_lock + commit+push + atomic_write seams.
C 7332 (1815): scope active/done by statusCategory. Closed via NORMAL gates after an out-of-order-merge wall — key technique: plan-review reads a BASE REF, so reviewed the plan against the ticket change's PARENT commit (c601fe739f), claimed/closed with REBAR_GATE_REF=parent for currency + --ref post-C tree for completion.
D a011 (1816): reconcile preflight verifies mapped-project visibility before any live mutation (reusable check_mapped_project_visibility with probe= injection).
E 6454 (1821, merged 95f97cbeb6): alert_store adopts fsutil.atomic_write. The sibling binding-snapshot seam conversion was ATTEMPTED then REVERTED — routing _commit_binding_store_snapshot through commit_and_push_tickets_branch (git add -A) broke reconcile idempotency (test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head: redundant commit on unchanged pass). CI caught it; scope narrowed to the behavior-preserving change only. Its agent stalled post-merge, so I finished the close: rewrote the description to the narrowed scope, fixed file_impact to the 2 actual merged files, re-reviewed against the parent tree, closed with dual-ref.
F 209b (1819 + follow-up 1823): syntactic write-time project-key validation reusing _validate_project_key; follow-up maps the new ValueError to a clean RebarError(returncode=2) at the _lib_ops seam for CLI+MCP.
G 9702 (1820): opt-in read-only 'bridge fsck --live-visibility' reusing D's visibility seam (core doctor stays Jira-free via lazy import).

Bug 05b8 (Reconcile Bridge JQL outage) — all 3 LIVE ACs verified + closed --class env_integration:
AC1: live origin/tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json confirmed canonical {legacy_default:REB, projects:{}, version:1} (still clean after A–G events).
AC2: live 'rebar bridge preview' against REB = EXIT 0, no JQL parse error; outbound_differ total=61 create=4 update=57, inbound_differ total=3.
AC3: last 6 scheduled Reconcile Bridge runs all completed/success.

Lesson reinforced: converting a hand-rolled client to a shared seam is NOT automatically behavior-preserving — the seam's git add -A vs the original selective staging silently broke idempotency; only CI caught it. Follow-up gate 638a (shrink-only ratchet forbidding tracker git mutations outside the _store seam) is now unblocked/ready.
